$comment: The strict settings every TypeScript project in this repo compiles under (issue #312). Path-bearing options (outDir, rootDir, include, exclude) stay in the leaf configs: `extends` resolves them relative to this file, so a leaf that inherited `outDir: dist` would emit into the server's build directory. Project references are deliberately not used - `npm run typecheck` runs each config with --noEmit, which keeps the check independent of the build.
